messages.subject: Lyra — sentencing exposure advice & analysis
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Attached are our advice note on sentencing exposure and the supporting analysis. In summary: on a guilty plea we estimate a fine of the order of £300,000 (realistic range £250k–£400k), plus HSE costs of about £24,600 and the victim surcharge — a total financial exposure of roughly £327,000. This assumes Medium culpability / Harm category 2, which counsel supports.

The key levers in our favour are the prompt remediation and full cooperation, and indicating a guilty plea early if the HSE charges, to secure the one-third credit. Happy to talk Andrew and Robert through this.

Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Strictly private and confidential.
